spec_case: electricity/docs/spec/tools-adapters-plugins.md §12 (a spawn error other than a missing binary)
description: `params.cwd` naming a plain file, not a directory (the case's own `orchestration.yml`), is a spawn failure `run_tracked`/`run_binary` don't special-case the way a missing binary is -- it must surface as its own `OSError` text (`NotADirectoryError`/`ENOTDIR`), never collapse into the same generic 'cancelled' text an actual cancellation uses. The OS's own strerror text is third-party, masked by the conformance harness's own message-shape catalogue (tests/conformance/README.md); the errno and the path stay exact.
